messages:
neel: CI on main is red for //core/runtime:fastpath on macos-smoke. Failing since toolchain roll earlier today. anyone seen this?

cara: saw it, stacktrace points to missing header include in third_party/rocksdb: fatal error: 'rocksdb/options.h' file not found

sam: pinging @miguel who did the roll. can you confirm image snapshot?

miguel: I rolled gcc-image at 12:30PT, didn't hit this locally. Can you paste the log?

neel: here's the relevant compile error:

```
/usr/local/include/rocksdb/options.h:10:10: fatal error: "port/port.h" file not found
#include "port/port.h"
         ^~~~~~~~~~~~~
1 error generated.
```

jen: looks like include path order changed; could be ccache or build flags.

cara: can we rerun the failing shard? @dev-ci-bot: scheduled rerun.

dev-ci-bot: Rerun started: https://ci.redwood/run/98321

sam: if rerun fails, can we bisect the toolchain image? I suspect the snapshot that bumped gcc changed -isystem ordering.

miguel: I'll add a bisect job. can someone mark the failing build URL and commit range?

neel: failing build: https://ci.redwood/run/98100, suspected images: gcc-image@sha256:abcd1234 -> efgh5678

cara: quick bisect helper:

```
scripts/toolchain-bisect --from abcd1234 --to efgh5678 --targets //core/runtime:fastpath
```

jen: @neel please attach full compile command with -v -E output if rerun fails.

dev-ci-bot: Rerun completed: FAILURE (same error). Added bisect job #383 to queue.

miguel: assigned to me. Running bisect now, will report first bad image.

sam: thanks. if bisect points to include ordering, we might need a hotfix in BUILD to add explicit include_directories.

cara: prepping a temporary CL 'hotfix/ci-macos-include' to land quickly.

neel: also proposing a toolchain snapshot smoke test to catch these. tagging infra.

infra-bot: created INFRA-512 'toolchain snapshot smoke tests' assigned to eng-infra.

miguel: bisect result: first bad image efgh5678. Root cause: image changed system header layout; need to add third_party/rocksdb/include to the cc_library includes. I'll open PR shortly.

sam: once PR lands can someone retrigger the green build?

jen: I'll requeue after PR merged. thanks all :rocket:
